case_assessment.reason_for_confidence: Seizure channel-level evidence is unavailable, and direct HFO-seizure channel concordance cannot be established.

hfo_assessment.summary: Strong consensus identified on LG8 and RC5; moderate consensus on RI11, RJ5, LG7, LG5, and LG4.

seizure_assessment.ictal_run_summary: Ictal run detected with 142 true ictal windows and 178 true nonictal windows.
seizure_assessment.interictal_run_summary: Interictal run shows high false-positive burden with 297 predicted positive windows.
seizure_assessment.summary: Seizure detection has high interictal false-positive burden, limiting confidence in seizure-channel associations.

integration_assessment.summary: HFO findings can be compared with seizure run behavior at the subject level, but direct spatial overlap cannot be claimed without seizure channel-level evidence.

limitations: Direct HFO-seizure channel concordance cannot be established.
final_interpretation: Strong HFO consensus on LG8 and RC5; moderate consensus on RI11, RJ5, LG7, LG5, and LG4. Seizure detection has high interictal false-positive burden, limiting confidence in direct channel associations.
